title: Long Day's Journey into Night

beats.what: Sara closes the diner and sends regulars home before dark
Boyd escorts Mr. Liu to the basement as night falls, establishing the locked-down routine
Something posing as Meagan's grandmother lures her to the window; Lauren pulls her back
Boyd confronts Frank about leaving his family unprotected; Meagan and Lauren are dead
Jim's RV is trapped in a looping road, tires shredded by a spike strip
Boyd introduces himself to Jim through the wrecked RV roof and begins extracting the family
Boyd tells Jim 'run as fast as you can, no matter what you see, you do not stop' as night falls
Ethan has a seizure in the RV as the creatures converge outside

character_beats.beat: Wants to protect the town yet cannot stop the Pratt deaths; spends the hour rescuing strangers while a child died on his watch the night before
Wants to stay calm and reassure his family yet is visibly losing control with each loop of the road
Wants rational explanations yet the evidence forces her toward panic

key_lines.line: A man protects his family, Frank!
key_lines.why: Establishes the town's core moral code and Frank's failure; the phrase repeats

key_lines.line: There's no such thing as monsters, honey.
key_lines.why: Jim's reassurance to Ethan is immediately undercut by everything the episode shows

key_lines.line: When you still expect to find the road that takes you home. It's the part that's cruel.
key_lines.why: A veteran resident names the psychological trap that defines the show's premise

key_lines.line: Run as fast as you can. No matter what you see, no matter what you hear, you do not stop.
key_lines.why: First full articulation of the survival rule; Boyd's voice, stakes immediately proven

key_lines.line: It's okay. I won't tell. It'll be our little secret.
key_lines.why: The creature's mimicry tactic introduced through the grandmother impersonation

open_loops: What are the creatures and where do they come from?
Why does the road loop endlessly back to the same town?
What is the talisman and why does it repel the creatures?
Why does Boyd carry guilt that feels personal beyond civic duty?
Who placed the spike strip on the road and why?

contradiction.wants: To keep every resident alive and get them home
contradiction.does: Enforces a system so rigid it failed to save Meagan and Lauren the very night before the episode begins

tone_notes: The episode's longest silence runs 91 seconds (07:49-09:20), bridging the diner closure to the creature-at-the-window sequence; the gap functions as a held breath before the first kill. Density spikes at minutes 32-36 (147-228 words/min) mark the frantic crash rescue. The opening minutes run thin (35-73 w/min), letting the mundane dusk routine establish stakes before the horror.
